mapper.select: SELECT reservation_no, member_email, hospital_id, hospital_name, hospital_type, hospital_address, hospital_phone, notification_phone, reservation_date, reservation_time, patient_name, message, status, reg_time, mod_time FROM tbl_hospital_reservation WHERE reservation_no = #{reservationNo}

SELECT reservation_no, member_email, hospital_id, hospital_name, hospital_type, hospital_address, hospital_phone, notification_phone, reservation_date, reservation_time, patient_name, message, status, reg_time, mod_time FROM tbl_hospital_reservation WHERE member_email = #{memberEmail} ORDER BY reservation_date DESC, reservation_time DESC, reg_time DESC
